description:
The image depicts a garden gnome, likely made of ceramic or plastic, sitting on the ground in front of a bush. The gnome is wearing a green hat, white shirt, blue overalls, and green shoes. It has a large smile and is holding a carrot in its left hand and a small shovel in its right hand.

The gnome is sitting on a bed of wood chips, surrounded by a bush with green leaves. The overall atmosphere of the image suggests a sunny day in a garden or yard
